name: ConfettiSaaS

sources.title: Submit page — URL-driven builder plus MCP-server submission for coding agents
Homepage — 'permanent do-follow links' promise, 353+ listed startups

conditions: Free submission is available, but the documented agent flow includes the agent 'installs the badge' on your site — a ConfettiSaaS badge embed is part of the listing pipeline
An email approve-link must be opened for the listing to land in your account
requirements: A SaaS/startup product with a public homepage the site (or MCP agent flow) can read
Every field is AI-generated from your homepage and fully editable — 'Nothing goes live until you review it'
preparation: Website URL only for the basic path — the builder reads the landing page and drafts the listing
For the agent path: add the MCP server https://confettisaas.com/mcp to Claude Code/Codex/Cursor/Windsurf or a Claude.ai/ChatGPT custom connector (no auth)
Access to the email inbox that receives the approve link
Ability to install a badge on the product site
workflow: Manual path: open https://confettisaas.com/submit, paste the homepage URL, let it draft the listing, edit fields, review, submit
Agent path: register the MCP server, then ask 'Submit https://yourproduct.com to ConfettiSaaS' — the agent writes the listing, installs the badge, and triggers an approve email
Open the emailed approve link to attach the listing to your account
Optionally buy sponsorship ($50 for 2 weeks / $70 for 4 weeks premium placement + newsletter feature)
watchFor: Badge installation is baked into the agent submission flow — decide before submitting whether you'll keep it
Sponsorship is an optional upsell; the base listing markets itself as permanent with do-follow links
AI-drafted copy needs human review — the site explicitly supports editing before anything goes live
countsAsLive: A listing page exists under confettisaas.com/saas/<slug> and the product appears in Listed products / Latest Submissions
unknowns: Whether the badge is strictly mandatory on the manual (non-MCP) path
